sentry_alert_rules.name: Critical tagged errors
sentry_alert_rules.description: Create in Sentry: Alerts > Create Alert > Issues. Filter: tags[alert] equals critical. Action: notify email or Slack.

sentry_alert_rules.name: Fatal level events
sentry_alert_rules.description: Create in Sentry: filter level:fatal for report_critical_error() events.

sentry_alert_rules.name: High server error rate
sentry_alert_rules.description: Create in Sentry: filter transaction.status_code:500 and service:day15-api.

kibana_alert_rules.name: Critical log severity
kibana_alert_rules.description: In Kibana: Stack Management > Rules. Query logs where severity <= 3 OR level is ERROR.

kibana_alert_rules.name: Readiness probe failures
kibana_alert_rules.description: Alert when health checks report database down.
